description: A PHP class for managing payment methods within the Goteo platform, including registration, removal, retrieval, and subscription handling.

classes.name: Payment
classes.description: A static class to manage payment methods, including adding, removing, and retrieving payment methods, as well as handling subscriptions.

methods.name: addMethod
methods.description: Registers a new payment method class, optionally forcing registration regardless of config.

methods.name: removeMethod
methods.description: Deregisters a payment method by its ID.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Returns all available payment methods, optionally instantiated with a user.

methods.name: methodExists
methods.description: Checks if a payment method exists by its ID.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Retrieves a specific payment method, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: defaultMethod
methods.description: Gets or sets the default payment method.

methods.name: getSubscriptionMethods
methods.description: Returns all payment methods that are subscription-based.

methods.name: isSubscriptionMethod
methods.description: Checks if a given method ID corresponds to a subscription payment method.
